purpose: Proper leave-family-out refit screen after rejecting coefficient-zero ablation as invalid for full one-hot categorical blocks and uncentered arsenal features.

method.solver_note: Converged L2 multinomial refit used as a computational screen; governed saga confirmation is required before model change.
method.live_equivalent_scoring: home_team nuisance block is zeroed/unknown on holdout inference, matching serialized live predictI2EventVector behavior

delta_definition: drop-family metric minus full-model metric; positive means family helps

screen_decisions.batter_identity: RETAIN_STRONG: large positive incremental value in both 2025 and 2026 under live-equivalent scoring
screen_decisions.pitcher_identity: RETAIN_STRONG: positive incremental value in both holdouts
screen_decisions.platoon: ADVANCE_TO_GOVERNED_SAGA_AND_FULL_I2_REMOVAL_TEST: removal improves both log loss and Brier in both holdouts
screen_decisions.arsenal: RETAIN_PENDING_STABILITY: essentially neutral/mixed in 2025 and positive in 2026; insufficient evidence to remove
screen_decisions.home_team_fit_only_nuisance: KEEP_FOR_NOW_PENDING_STABILITY: small sign reversal; not a live feature, and no consistent evidence that removing the fit control helps

invalidated_method: Do not use coefficient-zero family ablation as variable importance for this model. Full one-hot blocks and uncentered numeric interactions make zeroing coefficients change the fitted level/intercept.
next_phase: 25D governed saga refit of platoon-free challenger, followed by full-I2 replay; do not remove platoon from production before that gate.
superseded_result_note: The original results block scored home_team directly on the holdout and is retained only for audit traceability. Use results_live_equivalent for decisions.
